articles.title: Widdecombe suspect charged with planning terror act against Farage
articles.description: Counter terror police say the further charge comes after a "hugely intensive and complex investigation".

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
articles.description: The flydubai plane plunged more than 17,000ft two and a half hours into its journey before passengers and crew overpowered the attacker.

articles.title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says

articles.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
articles.description: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.
